notes: Defect: promo code discount amount is incorrect for return-trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. The code path that builds the Mozio dispatch payload for return trips (create-reservations.mappers.ts getTripData) and the mapper that surfaces the discount into the sanitized dispatch (map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts) are the likely fix sites. The return-trip branch swaps from/to stations but may not correctly propagate or compute the per-segment discount amount, causing the Mozio confirmation email to show an unexpected promo code value for the return leg.

notes: Openspec provided empty acceptanceCriteria with only diagnostic notes about likely fix sites. I created 8 ACs from scratch covering: (1) the core return-trip discount correctness bug, (2) one-way trip regression safety, (3) no-promo-code edge case, (4) percentage-based discount computation per segment, (5) fixed-amount discount propagation, (6) asymmetric base prices between outbound and return legs, (7) currency rounding edge case, (8) zero-value discount edge case. All ACs follow the What-Not-How rule — they describe observable outcomes in the Mozio confirmation email/dispatch payload, not implementation details. AC-4 and AC-6 specifically address the likely root cause described in openspec's notes (return-trip branch swapping stations may compute discount from the wrong segment's base price).
